entries.name: %history
entries.meaning: list every cell with its input and output; failed cells are marked !

entries.name: %rerun
entries.meaning: execute cell n's input again as a new cell

entries.name: %edit
entries.meaning: replace cell n's input and execute it as the next cell

entries.name: %save
entries.meaning: write all successful non-magic inputs to a replayable script

entries.name: %load
entries.meaning: replay a script file cell by cell; multi-line DEFs replay as ONE cell

entries.name: %reset
entries.meaning: clear the simulator state (cell history is kept)

_notes: A line whose first character is % never reaches the lexer.
Magics do NOT consume cell numbers — only executed commands become numbered cells.
An unknown magic replies: unknown magic `<name>` — see HELP
